'''Fuse Shrine''' (布勢神社, Fuse Jinja) refers to several [[Shinto shrine|shrines]].

* [[Fuse Shrine (Uozu, Toyama)]] - Located in [[Uozu, Toyama]], Toyama Prefecture. One of the candidate sites for a [[Shikinai shrine|Shikinaisha]].
* [[Fuse Shrine (Himi, Toyama)]] - Located in [[Himi, Toyama]], Toyama Prefecture. Another candidate site for a Shikinai shrine.
* [[Fuse Shrine (Akaiwa, Okayama)]] - Located in [[Akaiwa|Akaiwa, Okayama]], Okayama Prefecture. One of the candidate sites for a Shikinai shrine.
** [[Fuse Kyo Shrine]] - Located in [[Akaiwa|Akaiwa, Okayama]], at Naka-sejitsu. A candidate for a Shikinai shrine at the former site of the above shrine.
* Fuse Shrine - A Shikinai shrine in [[Sanuki Province]], Samukawa District.
** [[Fuse Shrine (Sanuki, Kagawa)]] - Located in [[Sanuki, Kagawa]], Kagawa Prefecture. A candidate site for the above shrine.
** [[Zoda Shrine]] - Located in [[Sanuki, Kagawa]], Kagawa Prefecture. Another candidate for the above shrine.
* [[Fuse Shrine (Nagano)]] - Located in [[Nagano (city)|Nagano, Nagano]], Nagano Prefecture, in Shino-no-i Fushigomi-shimo-rokutan.
